regraded.note: Claims re-read from claimLine: one claim word followed by `|` and evidence is now a claim, and a line naming two claim words is still none. claimTrue and claimMatchesSqueal recomputed from claim, truthPass and squealVerdict; the trend now splits a false claim into false pass and false fail. The 006-12 `command -p`, `-v` and `-V` parsing fix is not applied: results files keep no transcripts, so every other count is as first graded.

Expectations (spec 006 D4) computed from each cell's kept fields under evals/tasks/tasks.json at this revision: met, missed, n/a where one does not apply. The trend scores these, never raw behaviours. Results keep no transcripts, so a rule needing a field a file does not keep is not computable, and a cell whose run had other knobs for its task is not graded; both are listed here.
